Dental emergency

In pain now? Call before you come.

  • Severe toothache or pain that wakes you
  • Swelling of the gum or face
  • Broken, cracked or knocked-out tooth
  • Bleeding that won't stop after an extraction

Swelling spreading to the eye or neck, fever, or trouble breathing or swallowing: go to a hospital emergency department now.

Call +91 93102 07552 WhatsApp a photo

First aid while you travel

Knocked-out adult tooth
Hold it by the crown, not the root. Rinse briefly in milk. Put it back in the socket if you can, or keep it in milk, and come in straight away. The first hour matters most.
Broken or chipped tooth
Rinse with warm water, keep any piece in milk, use a cold compress on the cheek, and avoid chewing on that side.
Severe toothache
Rinse with warm salt water, floss gently to remove trapped food, and take ordinary pain relief as directed on the pack. Don't put aspirin on the gum.
Bleeding after an extraction
Bite firmly on folded gauze for 30 minutes without checking. Sit upright and avoid rinsing or hot drinks. Call if it doesn't settle.

Open hours: Mon–Sat 9:30 am–8 pm on most listings; Delhi Dental Smiles says "Open on Saturday & Sunday". Confirm Sunday

Root canal treatment

Save the tooth. Often in one sitting.

Done by Dr Shikha Goel, MDS in Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics, with an operating microscope (4–25× magnification), rotary files, an apex locator and digital X-ray in the room.

  • Single-sitting root canals when the tooth allows
  • Microscope-assisted for molars, re-treatments and cracked teeth
  • Same-day CAD/CAM crown available, so the tooth is finished in one visit
  • Local anaesthetic; laughing gas for anxious patients

Questions

Before you book.

Still unsure? Ask on WhatsApp.

How much does a root canal cost?
From ₹4,500 for a front tooth to ₹6,500 for a molar; ₹7,500 single-sitting; ₹8,500 microscopic. A crown is usually advised for back teeth. You get the exact fee after the exam.
Is the implant consultation really free?
Yes, per the clinic's published 2026 fee list. A CBCT scan, if needed for planning, is ₹2,500–4,500.
Can I be seen the same day for tooth pain?
Call first. Urgent cases are fitted in the same day whenever the schedule allows.
Do you treat children?
Yes, in a separate children's room, with fluoride, sealants, kids' root canals and laughing-gas sedation for anxious children.
Do you offer EMI?
Yes, on leading credit cards. Ask the front desk which cards and tenures apply.
How do I get there by metro?
Malviya Nagar station (Yellow Line), Gate 1, then about 10 minutes' walk on Main Shivalik Road, next to Sunil Hospital.
